entities.summary: Gyöngyi Likerecz is a retired female weightlifter from Hungary. She twice competed for her native country at the Summer Olympics in the women's heavyweight division. Likerecz was named Hungarian Sportswoman of the Year in 2001 after having won the world title the same year in Antalya, Turkey.
